description: CSUTLDTC, the called date-validation subprogram, invoked as the @Service it became. LS-DATE='2022-07-19' and LS-DATE-FORMAT='YYYY      ' are this case's two LINKAGE SECTION parameters (L84-L85); LS-RESULT PIC X(80) (L86) is the output and is asserted below as the single WS_MESSAGE_80 line. This program opens no file and is reached by no JCL, so it seeds no dataset, writes no record and takes no job parameter - its entire observable behaviour is the 80 bytes L97 moves into LS-RESULT and the severity L98 moves into RETURN-CODE. Expected values are STATICALLY DERIVED from the 01 WS-MESSAGE declaration at L42-L57 and the group move at L122, never captured from a COBOL run: no Language Environment exists here, so CEEDAYS cannot be called at all. Arm 2 of the EVALUATE TRUE at L128-L149 is FC-INSUFFICIENT-DATA, matched at L131, and L132 moves the twelve-character literal 'Insufficient' into WS-RESULT PIC X(15), which right-pads it with three spaces and carries it exactly as written rather than expanded. Severity 0003 and message number 2507 are DECODED from that arm's own 88-level VALUE X'000309CB59C3C5C5' at L63 - halfword 0x0003 is SEVERITY, halfword 0x09CB is MSG-NO = 2507 - and never interpolated from a neighbour, because the tokens at L62-L70 run 0000, 2507, 2508, 2509, 2513, 2517, 2518, 2520, 2521 and so skip 2510-2512, 2514-2516 and 2519; the trailing 59C3C5C5 is the severity-control byte and the facility id 'CEE', and reaches no span. This is arm 2 by its second route, a well-formed mask carrying only a year, which is what separates 2507 from the 2518 of a malformed picture string; case05 reaches the same arm with a wholly blank mask. The mask's declared ten-byte width is load-bearing at L122, where the group move overwrites what L107-L108 left in WS-DATE with the leftmost ten bytes of WS-DATE-TO-TEST - the halfword 0x000A that L105 stored from LENGTH OF LS-DATE, then only the first eight characters of the date - so '2022-07-19' is truncated to '2022-07-' and two binary bytes stand at offsets 45 and 46. That is preserved expected output, not a value to tidy or trim; WS-DATE-FMT at [66,76) survives clean because L122 targets WS-DATE alone. Both callers reject this outcome: CORPT00C at L396 and L416 and COTRN02C at L397 and L417 test CSUTLDTC-RESULT-SEV-CD = '0000' then CSUTLDTC-RESULT-MSG-NUM NOT = '2513', reading as four-character strings the spans this case pins at [0,4) and [15,19).
